spec: draft-deus-aar-05 (rev 4.6). Abstract vectors D/S/V (221) and byte vectors cose/C01-C82 (82). -04 baseline (with ERRATA-04): 178 abstract + C01-C82.
level: abstract (semantic) vectors: signatures and hashes are symbolic; signature validity is an input flag. Byte-level vectors in cose/ are real COSE_Sign1 (kid = RFC 9679 thumbprint). In abstract sequence vectors action.t is a harness shorthand: the witness clock reads at least t before the step (Appendix A).
units: amounts are integer minor units (USD cents); times are seconds on the witness clock
class: valid = honest trace, conforming implementation MUST allow/accept/validate; invalid = attack or malformed input, MUST deny, defer, reject or invalidate
